facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, but bring export earnings to an Algerian bank within 120 days.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: a professional FX account holds 100% of repatriated service earnings.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Chargily Pay accepts local CIB and EDAHABIA cards; international cards not yet.
facts.L1_registration: Auto-entrepreneur: register online with ANAE, turnover under about DZD 5m a year.
facts.L2_tax_id: NIF tax number, plus CASNOS registration for auto-entrepreneurs.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Auto-entrepreneurs pay a 0.5% IFU on turnover instead of income tax and VAT.
facts.L5_data_protection: Law 18-07: declare data processing to the ANPDP beforehand.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Law 18-05: show your registration number; returns allowed for late deliveries.
facts.L7_incentives: 0.5% auto-entrepreneur tax and 100% foreign-currency retention for service exports.
facts.D1_id_document: Biometric national ID card (CNI) with your NIN.

watch_out.text: Repatriate within 120 days; guides from before August 2026 still say 360.
Withdrawing PayPal funds in Algeria is unclear; there's no official list of working cards.
